text:
Jamal: FYI we got another flaky return candidate, g2-45 in us-west-2. Overnight soak produced repeated Xid 13s and a spike in ECC correctable errors. I pulled the logs and it looks thermal-ish but not conclusive.

Anya: Can you paste the snip of nvidia-smi/error counters? quick check first. :eyes: 

Jamal: Pasted below from last 6h (trimmed):
```
Timestamp  ECC_Corrected  ECC_Uncorrected  Xid_Errors
2026-03-16T02:10  12              0                 1
2026-03-16T06:12  45              0                 3
2026-03-16T11:03  82              1                 7
```
Seems to correlate with a thermal bump around 06:00 (warmup cycle).

Liam: Not great. Does it reproduce on our bench soak loop or only in-cluster?

Jamal: Repro on short soak (6h) in-cluster, but lab soak script is more deterministic. I want to run a 72h thermal+PCIe stress soak in the lab with forced fan curves and randomized pcie resets. Should we move it out of rotation now?

Evelyn: Move out of rotation and label as quarantined until lab verify. Add a tag: "quarantine/thermal-investigation". Also book bench-3 for 72h starting 03/17.

Jamal: Done. I queued the node for drain and copied disk images to bench. Drain command I used: `rbctl drain --node g2-45 --reason "quarantine-thermal"` and patched routing to fallback model variants. ops-bot confirmed drain in channel.

ops-bot: Node g2-45 has been drained and marked quarantined by Jamal at 2026-03-16T12:02. Bench slot assigned: bench-3.

Anya: For the lab run, let's use the new soak harness: `soak-loop.sh --thermal-profile aggressive --pcie-flip 60m --collect-telemetry`. Please ensure diag collection runs every 30m. Add `--watchdog-restart` so we capture hangs.

Jamal: Running: `./soak-loop.sh --thermal-profile aggressive --pcie-flip 60m --duration 72h --collect-interval 30m --outdir /tmp/g2-45-soak`. Hooked up IPMI monitor and ambient probe in rack.

Liam: Pass/fail criteria we agreed on last month:
- No new Xid errors for 72h after thermal cycles OR Xid count delta <= 2
- ECC correctable errors delta < 100 over 72h and no uncorrected ECC
- PCIe reset count stable (no more than 1 automated flip)
If any of these fail, escalate to HW vendor RMA with full diag bundle.

Evelyn: Also add a test matrix to reproduce with varying host loads: idle, throughput (tensor), and burst. Sometimes stress-only reproduces different flakes.

Jamal: Noted. I'll run three sequential 24h phases: idle -> throughput -> burst. Will attach logs to the ticket: INFRA-2749.

Anya: Small automation tip — use `diag-collect.sh` once an Xid appears to snapshot KPIs:
```
./diag-collect.sh --node g2-45 --since 6h --out /tmp/INFRA-2749/g2-45-snap
```
It collects `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q`, `lspci -vv`, and IPMI logs. Attach to the ticket and vendor support.

Jamal: Ran diag-collect at first failure and uploaded to INFRA-2749. Pattern shows Xid originating right after a PCIe link retrain: `pcie 0000:65:00.0: link down` then `link up`.

Liam: That suggests either connector/slot or GPU firmware oddball. Try reseating and running the same 24h throughput phase. If it repros, we escalate RMA. If not, we suspect intermittent connector corroding under thermal cycling.

Evelyn: Also consider running the same soak on a different slot in the same chassis to rule out slot vs card. We have spare slot bench-4 available.

Jamal: Good plan. I'll swap to bench-4 after this 24h idle phase. If bench-4 shows same pattern immediately, escalate.

Anya: For cost/ops notes: doing 72h lab soak costs ~0.6 reserved-hour equivalent and we should avoid running more than 4 concurrent benches to keep spare capacity for prod. Documented in infra runbook.

Jamal: Will update INFRA-2749 with timeline, bench switches, and final verdict. I'll ping here when we have a pass or we open RMA. :thumbsup:

Evelyn: Thanks — if RMA required, include pcie logs, ambient temps, and binary firmware versions. Vendor wants those up front.

ops-bot: Reminder: bench-3 reserved for Jamal until 2026-03-19T12:02.
